title: TTP-Linked Quadcopter Drops Explosives on Haved Police Station, Bannu
detail: A TTP-linked quadcopter drone dropped two explosive devices on the Haved police station in Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, on June 25, 2026. Two Frontier Corps personnel, Sepoy Ghulam Zada and Sepoy Saddam, sustained minor injuries, and two government vehicles were damaged. The attack is part of a documented shift by TTP-affiliated cells toward small quadcopter/FPV drone tactics in the Bannu area.

media.caption: A TTP-linked quadcopter dropped explosives on a police station in Bannu, injuring two FC personnel.

title: Georgetown Report: 'Five Years of Taliban Rule' Documents Normalization of Gender Apartheid
detail: The Georgetown Institute for Women, Peace and Security (GIWPS) published 'Five Years of Taliban Rule: The Normalization of Gender Apartheid and the International Community's Failure,' arguing that roughly 20 million Afghan women and girls live under systematic exclusion from public life, ranking Afghanistan the world's worst country to be a woman, and warning that the international community is normalizing rather than confronting the situation.

sources.name: Georgetown Institute for Women, Peace and Security — Taliban Normalization of Gender Apartheid and International Failure

media.caption: A Georgetown report warns the international community is normalizing five years of Taliban gender apartheid.
